title: Remi · Foundations

regions.label: #dc-root
lines: Tokens, type, spacing, motion and the core components. Colour and type values are stand-ins until the Ninety One values arrive; components read tokens only, so the swap touches :root and nothing else. Open Remi.dc.html for the working screens.
Colour carries meaning and only meaning. On track is the neutral default.
Warm off-white paper, near-black ink. Saturation stays under 0.01.
Idle checkboxes, separators · not for body text
One accent per domain; same lightness and chroma, different hue. Soft tints derive from the accent.
Used sparingly. Chip text mixes the status colour into ink so it holds 4.5:1.
At risk: overrun past target, stale
Seven sizes. The serif is reserved for goal statements and day headings.
Refined grotesk for all interface text. Stand-in for the brand face.
Goal statements and day headings only. Tweakable off.
Business-day numbers, hours and any column of figures. Body text also sets tabular-nums.
The ManCo pack builds itself from source data.
Goal statements in lists and panels
Every Private Credit exit lands before 4 Jan.
Whitespace and hairlines instead of boxes inside boxes.
1920 × 1080; checked at 2560 × 1440 (content widens, row heights hold)
48px margins, 12 columns, 24px gutters; 72px between major columns
40px list rows, 64px timeline project rows, hairline between
None, except drawer, palette and tooltip: one soft shadow each
Alive, never busy. Motion explains a change; nothing loops.
Feedback: hover, press, tick fill, linked highlight.
Layout: glides, zoom, drawers. Nothing runs longer than 600ms.
Opacity and colour. Kept in reduced motion.
Critically damped spring. Motion: { type: "spring", bounce: 0, visualDuration: 0.35 } ≈ stiffness 180, damping 27.
1 · glide Bar end and overrun move on --spring-soft, 440ms. Motion: spring, bounce 0, visualDuration 0.35.
2 · ghost Old end appears at full strength, holds 1000ms, fades 400ms --ease-out. The dashed track of the previous plan stays, faint.
3 · roll Dates and counts roll per digit, weekday and month on --spring-soft, 440ms.
4 · delta chip Fades and scales 0.9 → 1 in 180ms, holds 5s beside the bar, then fades.
glide 440 spring · ghost 1000 hold + 400 fade · roll 440 spring · chip 180
Runs 220ms after the drawer closes so the eye is back on the plan. Only affected bars move.
Hovering a project anywhere dims everything that is not it: bars, capacity segments, chips, feed.
The goal sentence is the shared element; it grows from 26px in the list to 48px in the header. Reduced motion: cross-fade.
Columns, bars, ticks and header labels re-lay out together; no cut. Pan by week in two-week view.
Fills from empty on arrival. Overload pulses once (600ms ring, 450ms delay), then holds still.
First load only. Screens stay mounted, so switching screens is a 240ms cross-fade, not a replay.
A small press-and-settle. Text drops to muted with a --done strike-through; progress count rolls.
Movement resolves instantly; opacity cross-fades remain. Mirrors prefers-reduced-motion and the Motion tweak.
Named as they will be in the build. BAU is a tick or chip; a project is a bar.
Overload · 9.5h of 8h · the whole bar turns red and pulses once
Timeline strip: one stacked bar per business day, 5px per hour.
A successor can run every PC process alone from written runbooks.
The ManCo pack builds itself from source data; the analyst only writes commentary.
Scope added (security-level attribution, +10h). Forecast moved 27 Nov → 2 Dec.
Add 6h of scope to Returns pipeline
No scope added since the charter. The plan is still the one you wrote.
Every plan has had a check-in this week. Next due: FI onboarding, last checked 5 days ago.
Not written yet. What must v0 do on its first day?
No premortem yet. Picture January with this project abandoned, and write down the first reason that comes to mind.
Side panel (460px) and check-in drawer (1160px) slide from the right on --spring-soft over an 18% ink scrim; see them live in the app.
